messages:
mina: hi team :wave: starting week 1 and hitting a couple cloud blockers. trying to create a tiny GKE cluster in project redwood-labs-eu (europe-west3) and getting 'Permission denied: billingNotLinked' and also an org-policy block saying 'AllowedLocations: violation'. on top of that the AWS onboarding assume-role returns an external-id mismatch. unsure who to cc to get billing linked across multiple regions and to fix the AWS external-id. any fast-unblock steps?

jordan: welcome Mina! short flow: 1) confirm people-ops sent billing invite and you accepted it 2) if billing accepted but project still shows unlinked, infra needs to attach billing (org policy can block until billing link is attached) 3) AWS external-id issues usually mean the onboarding-team set an external-id and it doesn't match what your CI/CLI is sending. paste errors and commands and we'll triage.

mina: thanks. gcloud i ran:
```
gcloud container clusters create tiny-test --project=redwood-labs-eu --zone=europe-west3-b --num-nodes=1 --machine-type=e2-small
```
console shows two messages: "Billing not enabled for project redwood-labs-eu" and "Creation blocked by organization policy: constraints/compute.allowedRegions (europe-west3 not in allowed list)"
for AWS i ran:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::333222111000:role/Redwood-Onboard --role-session-name mina-test --external-id 0000-aaaa-1111
```
and got: "An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: External ID does not match the role's configured external ID."

kevin: hey Mina, people-ops usually sends billing invites but the multi-region billing mapping is done by infra for sandbox projects. @people-ops can you confirm billing-account id? @infra-setup-bot if org-policy blocks creation we may need a policy exception for the project or to approve europe-west3 as allowed for onboarding projects.

people-ops: sent the billing invite on day 0 to your work email, re-sent just now. billing-account for onboarding projects is 1111-2222-3333. if you accepted and it still shows unlinked, reply here and infra will attach billing. note: for multi-region access we normally only allow europe-west1 and europe-west4 by default; request an exception for europe-west3 with justification 'new-hire short test'.

infra-setup-bot: received request: attach billing for project redwood-labs-eu and request org-policy exception to allow europe-west3 for onboarding. ticket INF-9001 created. Action: attach billing-account 1111-2222-3333 and add temporary allowedRegion europe-west3 for 48 hours. ETA 3 hours. For AWS external-id: confirm the external-id value expected by the role. Provide the role arn and your caller identity and cloud-ops will validate the trust policy.

cloud-ops: quick tip for AWS external-id: the role's trust policy can list the ExternalId it expects. If your CLI or CI is adding a different external-id (or none), it fails. If you don't know the expected external-id, DM the role arn to us and we'll fetch the AssumeRolePolicyDocument and report back. Also check that you're using the onboarding profile (aws profile 'onboarding') not your personal profile.

mina: accepted the billing invite from the resend (it was in Updates tab). i also double-checked and my aws CLI was using my default profile by mistake. switched to `--profile onboarding` and tried assume-role again with the external-id from the onboarding doc and got a different error: "Invalid principal in policy". i DM'd the role arn to cloud-ops.

jordan: good find about profile. infra, if INF-9001 ETA slips ping me. Mina, once billing is attached you may still need the service account IAM role `roles/container.clusterAdmin` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` to create the cluster; request those if you hit permission denied after billing/org-policy fix.

cloud-ops: checked trust policy for arn:aws:iam::333222111000:role/Redwood-Onboard — it referenced a principal `arn:aws:iam::333222111000:user/onboard-bot` which was rotated. updated trust to reference the onboarding role `arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/OnboardingFacade` and removed stale principal. patched role; try again.

infra-setup-bot: update INF-9001: billing attached to redwood-labs-eu and org-policy temporary exception granted for europe-west3 for 48 hours. ticket closed. If you need longer window request justification via the infra form.

mina: cluster create now proceeded! also used `gcloud auth login --scopes=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform` and granted `roles/container.clusterAdmin` to my user. aws assume-role now succeeds with onboarding profile. thanks everyone for the rapid help :tada:

jordan: welcome aboard Mina! once you finish your smoke tests post any logs here. if you need persistent europe-west3 access we can submit a permanent policy change via product. :rocket:
